evidence.note: Claim detection hoisted before the golden-match skip and the no-evidence continue: the claims-made denominator counts matched, adjudicated and kept-for-human claims alike; a matched gap claim counts confirmed but NOT confirmed_without_evidence (the match verified the finding, not the asserted absence)

Rollup classifies the FINAL outcome after escalation resolves, distinguishing VerdictRealButUngold (confirmed) from VerdictCheckedButUnverified (unverified); empirical mixed-run probe (gap + non-gap + parse-error arm + absent-file claim) reproduced the identity claims == confirmed + rejected + unverified exactly: {claims:3, rejected:1, unverified:2}

secondOpinion carries the gap-claim evidence discipline: ContextForGapClaim context, Claim on the escalated Request (audit row keeps claim_class/claim_evidence); discarded evidence return is safe — ContextForGapClaim is deterministic over the same diff/finding, and claim.Evidence from the first arm is identical
callAs audits req.Claim into LLMCallData for both arms; judge-error aborts return before any rollup emission, so no partial-count record can be written

ClaimClass/ClaimEvidence are omitempty additions; fold.go decodePayload (DisallowUnknownFields) decodes the same-package struct, so audit round-trip and replay are unaffected; run package tests pass fresh (-count=1)

Frozen eval data, wiring verified: 131 records, 0 duplicate (issue_text,diff_file) pairs, all diff_file references exist, 0 dangling evidence paths (every evidence path is a section in its referenced minimized diff), 58 no-diff records all expect empty evidence, note field round-trips; aggregate pins 21 hallucinated gap-claims / 14 with evidence match the full-lab measurement (cmd/claimcheck-eval: 14/21)

findings.note: Metric semantics boundary (not a defect): with_evidence counts only claims that reached the adjudication context selection — golden-matched and absent-file gap claims are counted in claims but never searched, so with_evidence can be less than the number of claims whose diff actually carries covering tests. The code comment documents the adjudicated-claim scope; if the metric is ever used to compute a per-claim evidence rate, the denominator should be adjudicated claims (claims minus matched minus unverified-no-evidence), or matched claims should also run the (deterministic, free) evidence search.

evidence.note: gapEvidence++ only on the adjudication path; the seen-skip and no-evidence continue increment claims without any search
